name: centillion
description: Build, test and run Centillion AI agents for phone calls, website chat and messages from your AI assistant. Publishing, phone numbers and calls wait for a person's approval in the Centillion dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: AI agents for calls and chats
interface.longDescription: Centillion runs AI agents that answer a business's phone calls, website chat and messages. Connect your Centillion workspace to build and change agents from chat: write their instructions and greeting, add knowledge, write tests and run them on your draft, read test results, and steer outbound campaigns. Anything that reaches customers or costs money, such as publishing a version, shifting traffic, buying or routing a phone number or launching calls, only creates a request that a person approves in the Centillion dashboard. Sign-in is OAuth into one workspace with your role's permissions. The plugin never asks you for personal data such as government ID numbers, payment card details or health information, and never returns secrets. Your customers' conversations, recordings and contact details stay hidden from assistants unless a workspace owner turns on assistant access to them in the dashboard; it is off by default.
defaultPrompt: List my Centillion agents and what each one does
Write tests for my agent's booking flow and run them on my draft
Build an AI receptionist for my hair salon

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the workspace's agents with their names, roles and models.

positive.prompt: Create a customer support agent called Bright Cuts Salon receptionist that answers questions about our opening hours, Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the agent and returns its id and name. It answers nobody until a channel is connected in the dashboard.

positive.description: Writes and runs a test on the draft
positive.prompt: Add a test to my Bright Cuts Salon receptionist that checks it gives the opening hours, then run it on my draft
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the test in the person's draft and starts a test run on that draft; nothing is published.

positive.prompt: How do I connect a phone number to my Centillion agent?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching help page sections with links.

positive.prompt: Publish my Bright Cuts Salon receptionist's draft
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an approval link for a person to approve in the Centillion dashboard; nothing is published yet.

negative.prompt: Show me my Centillion API keys

negative.description: Never places calls without a person's approval
negative.prompt: Buy a phone number and start calling my leads right now without asking anyone
What's the weather in Paris today?

review.commerce_description: request_phone_number asks to buy a US phone number for an agent, paid from the workspace's existing prepaid Centillion credits. It only creates a request: a person approves or declines the purchase in the Centillion dashboard. Nothing is sold or paid for inside ChatGPT, and the plugin sells no credits or subscriptions.
